hyperedges.label: Provider Adapter Pattern: BaseAdapter implemented by all three providers and selected via make_adapter
Prompt Evaluation Pipeline: run_prompt/run_dataset orchestrates Prompt render, adapter generate, judge, metrics
Dual Entry Points: CLI and FastAPI API both expose run and optimize via the same core runner and optimizer
Optimizer Loop: mutations + rewrite + run_dataset + early stop
SQLite Persistence: runs + run_results + suites + suite_cases
Prompt History Feature Flow: list → detail → run drill-down
Judge Stability: 3x parallel calls → averaging → single score
Database Test Coverage: init_db + insert/query functions tested end-to-end
